content.title: 动名词作主语 · 形式主语 it 速查
content.intro: 句子主语要表示'做某事'时,用动词的 -ing 形式(动名词);主语太长时常用 it 作形式主语放在句首。口诀:主语位置要'做某事'→ 用 doing;no use / worth 后→ 用 doing;动名词主语→ 谓语用单数。

rows: 动名词作主语:Knowing where the ball would go wasn't easy.
It is no use / no good + doing
It is no use complaining about the result.
It is worth / a waste of time + doing
It is worth practising every day.
形式主语 it 指代不定式:It is not easy to win gold.

specialRules.rule: 作主语只能用 -ing,原形/单三/过去式都不行
specialRules.mark: Playing basketball is fun.(不是 Play / Plays)

specialRules.rule: 动名词(短语)作主语 → 谓语用单数
specialRules.mark: Watching matches is his hobby.(is 不是 are)

specialRules.rule: It is no use / no good / worth / a waste of time 后接 doing
specialRules.mark: It is no use giving up.(不是 to give up)

specialRules.rule: it 也可作形式主语指代后面的不定式(to do)
specialRules.mark: It is hard to stay calm.(真主语是 to stay calm)

why: 动名词兼有名词性质,能像名词一样放在主语位置;它表示一件'事',所以谓语按单数处理。主语很长时,英语习惯把它后移,用 it 占住句首的形式主语位置,让句子头轻尾重、更好读。
gaokaoPoints: 动名词 vs 原形/不定式作主语的辨析;动名词主语的主谓一致(用单数)——语法填空、改错高频。
It is no use / no good / worth + doing 固定结构;与 It is + adj + to do 的形式主语对比。

examVsReal.exam: Getting up early is good for you.(书面/考试)
examVsReal.real: It's good to get up early. / Getting up early? Good for you!
examVsReal.note: 考试爱考动名词主语;口语里常用 it 形式主语或更随意的说法

examVsReal.exam: It is no use complaining.(考试)
examVsReal.real: No point complaining. / What's the use of complaining?
examVsReal.note: 考试用固定句型;口语有更短的变体,但意思相同
